name: Izagre (Spain)
description: Crimson field with a white triangle with its base along the hoist bearing the crowned municipal arms of Izagre, and a green triangle edged yellow with its apex at the fly.
history: Municipal flag of Izagre; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
